title: Colombian coffee smallholder, two dry seasons (English)
profile_note: Synthetic producer (#7): coffee smallholder, Cauca, Colombia, with drip irrigation and shade tree projects. Regional data and peer examples exist, so the answer has full evidence. Contrast pairs C1 (with SYN-005, S7) and C4 (with SYN-008).

turns.message: It hasn't rained like it used to. I've had two seasons of very irregular rain and last year's coffee harvest on my plot dropped a lot.
It started at the end of 2024. I lost about a third of the crop. I planted more shade trees over the coffee, but it wasn't enough.

args.text: It wasn't a third, it was almost half the harvest.

intake_replies: I put in drip lines and saved water in tanks, but the rain just did not come.
